ask: can u mkae a chore pikcer so evryone claims one
sentence: A shared list of chores where each person claims one spot, can switch or drop it, and the card shows who has what and how many people still need a chore.
use_when: A group wants to split weekly household chores so each person takes one
Everyone should pick a task from a fixed list with limited spots
You want to see at a glance who has claimed what and who is left
Roommates or family need a quick sign-up for shared tasks
dont_use_when: The group needs a vote to decide between options, not to assign tasks
Tasks need due dates, reminders, or repeating schedules
Chores should be assigned automatically or by rotation instead of chosen
